items.label: Who is Icaro as a builder?
items.prompt: Build a deep professional profile of Icaro Glauco: identity, transformation practice, current focus, capabilities, working principles and suitable project relationships.

items.label: Why Wizard of Transformation?
items.prompt: Explain why Icaro Glauco uses the title Wizard of Transformation. Treat it as a professional method and connect perception, naming, composition, materialisation and refinement to his software practice.

items.label: How does a vague idea become software?
items.prompt: Explain Icaro's transformation method from an ambiguous business or knowledge situation to an explicit domain, product architecture, governed AI responsibility, implementation and evidence.

items.label: Profile Cognoscere / Lumira
items.prompt: Present Cognoscere and Lumira as a complete flagship-project profile. Explain their relationship, actors, independent domains, product layers, knowledge flow, implemented evidence, boundaries and roadmap.

items.label: Profile Isocon Licitações
items.prompt: Present Isocon Licitações Inteligentes as a complete project profile, focusing on local AI, edital ingestion, company knowledge, requirements, risks, documentary compliance and the current product boundary.

items.label: Profile MacroObras
items.prompt: Present MacroObras as a complete project profile, showing how administration, collaborators, field routines, camera evidence, construction diaries and measurement comparison form one operational chain.

items.label: Compare the three active products
items.prompt: Compare Cognoscere/Lumira, Isocon Licitações Inteligentes and MacroObras by domain, actors, knowledge model, operational flow, intelligence boundary, evidence and current phase.

items.label: What does OKF do here?
items.prompt: Explain the role of OKF across Icaro's work: domain vocabulary, relations, provenance, public projections, protected intelligence and operational continuity. Use project evidence where available.

items.label: What can I hire Icaro to build?
items.prompt: Based only on the profile, method and active projects, describe the specialised software work Icaro is prepared to design and build, the best-fit situations and the engagement path.
